method.rq1: Equal-fold MAE/RMSE on common complete country-target rows within each program-domain. Country-cluster bootstrap of paired MAE contrasts; PISA uses the matched registered TimesFM historical panel.
method.rq2: Existing LOCO M0/M1/Persistence predictions, complete-key comparison, equal weighting of target folds, paired country-cluster bootstrap.
method.bootstrap_interval: Percentile 95% interval from 5,000 resamples of country IDs with all observed target-fold rows retained per sampled country.

source_scope: No models refit; this script summarizes saved predictions. It does not alter existing source outputs.
